nodes.label: Reference Video Studio SaaS ULW Plan
Must Not Have Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Explicitly prevents diffusion replacement, flattened UI, unmeasured prose, fallback trajectories, VLM deletion, unbound VFX/SFX, and unsupported market claims.

nodes.label: Path Based Provenance
nodes.rationale: Source paths and optional hashes identify origin but are intentionally not validation gates.

nodes.label: Evidence First Pipeline
nodes.rationale: A successful encode is not quality approval; model labels are not measured observations.

nodes.label: Forbidden Admin Actions
nodes.rationale: Admin operations can support safety and operations but cannot approve gates, rewrite receipts, mutate render output, or add hash gating.

nodes.label: Evidence First Admin UI
nodes.rationale: The UI must show measured evidence and blocking reasons before actions and never collapse states into generic success.

nodes.label: Research Ledger Decisions
nodes.rationale: Temporal volume, owner segmentation, VLM label-only boundaries, and fail-closed ambiguity govern the interpretation contract.

nodes.label: VLM Label Only Boundary
nodes.rationale: VLM can name semantic categories but cannot delete, replace, invent, or hide measured pixel/temporal layers.
